source.section: PDF page 12, Line 6 (federal AGI); PDF page 14, Line 11 NC Standard Deduction Chart, Line 14 and Line 15 (4.25%); PDF page 7, 'What is the Tax Rate?' (married filing separately, spouse does not claim itemized deductions: 12,750)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 50,750.00. The spouse takes the NC standard deduction (does not itemize), so the chart gives 12,750. Federal taxable income = 50,750.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 35,000.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). D-400 Line 6 federal AGI 50,750.00. Line 7 additions (Schedule S Part A) 0.00. Line 8 = Line 6 + Line 7 = 50,750.00. Line 9 deductions (Schedule S Part B) 0.00. Line 10 child deduction 0.00 (no qualifying children). Line 11 NC standard deduction (married_separate) 12,750.00. Line 12a = Lines 9 + 10 + 11 = 12,750.00; Line 12b = Line 8 - Line 12a = 38,000.00. Line 14 NC taxable income (full-year resident) = 38,000.00. Line 15 tax = 38,000.00 x 0.0425 = 1,615.00. Line 16 credits 0.00; Line 17 income tax = 1,615.00.
